items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I started doing club dates with people like Howard Bunce

ctx.x: Yeah. And I started doing club dates with people like Howard Bunce and an especially good friend of mine in those days, he was very helpful to me -- I don't know exactly how I met him, maybe it was through Howard Bunce, was Everett Barksdale, a guitarist. He's a very busy guitar player in Detroit in those days, and he put in a good word for me and my brother.
I guess we're getting to be around when I was about 17 years old in those days.
